findings.evidence: Line 13 uses plain `import TauCeti.Algebra.Central.TensorProduct`, while the centrality instance is declared only in `Algebra/Central/TensorProduct.lean:101`; the examples at lines 244–247 run inside the privately importing module.
findings.fix: Make `TauCeti.Algebra.Central.TensorProduct` a public import (and remove any now-redundant direct public imports), or provide a public umbrella module that reexports both closure instances.
findings.issue: `TauCeti.Algebra.Central.TensorProduct` is a private import, so downstream users importing this module receive the simplicity instance but not `Algebra.IsCentral.tensorProduct`; the in-file inference example therefore does not validate the advertised central-simple closure interface for consumers.

summary: The central-simple tensor-product module does not transitively expose the centrality half of the closure API it advertises.
